name: Press (Smith Machine)
instructions: Set a bench under the Smith bar and position it at shoulder height.
Unrack and press the bar overhead to full extension.
The fixed path lets you focus on pressing without stabilizing.
Lower with control to shoulder height. A stable overhead press option.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: A beginner Smith machine press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Press (Smith Machine) builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
